headline: Ambuja Cements Limited: Shareholders meeting
sum: Shareholders meeting - Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome and proceedings of NCLT Convened General Meeting held on September 29, 2026 in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of  ACC Limited with the…
detail: Shareholders meeting - Ambuja Cements Limited has informed the Exchange regarding outcome and proceedings of NCLT Convened General Meeting held on September 29, 2026 in relation to the Scheme of Amalgamation of  ACC Limited with the Company. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Scrutinizers report along with voting results.
